description: This file defines various quantized activation modules and classes for PyTorch, including ReLU6, Hardswish, ELU, LeakyReLU, Sigmoid, Softmax, MultiheadAttention, and PReLU, with methods for conversion from float modules and handling quantization parameters.

classes.name: ReLU6
classes.description: Quantized ReLU6 activation class with in-place option and conversion from float.

classes.name: Hardswish
classes.description: Quantized Hardswish activation class with support for scale and zero_point, including conversion methods.

classes.name: ELU
classes.description: Quantized ELU activation class with scale, zero_point, and alpha parameters, including conversion methods.

classes.name: LeakyReLU
classes.description: Quantized LeakyReLU activation class with negative_slope, scale, zero_point, and conversion methods.

classes.name: Sigmoid
classes.description: Quantized Sigmoid activation class with scale and zero_point, including conversion method.

classes.name: Softmax
classes.description: Quantized Softmax activation class with dim, scale, zero_point, and conversion methods.

classes.name: MultiheadAttention
classes.description: Quantizable MultiheadAttention class with methods for conversion from observed modules.

classes.name: PReLU
classes.description: Quantized PReLU class with scale, zero_point, number of parameters, and conversion methods.

methods.name: from_float
methods.description: Converts a float module to its quantized counterpart, using activation_post_process to calculate quantization parameters.

methods.name: from_reference
methods.description: Creates a quantized module from a reference float module, with specified scale and zero_point.

methods.name: set_weight
methods.description: Sets the weight tensor for PReLU.
